title: The Plant Room Door
author: Gus Tremblay
text: Sticky notes, index cards and torn binder pages, layered on the door. The top one: "Every morning. Oil first. Number 1 drinks." Under it: "Read suction, discharge, oil glass on BOTH machines, glycol out and back. Write it in the log WITH THE PENCIL ON THE STRING." The binder is taped to the door.
noticed: The log book is open on the desk inside, pencil on a string.

title: On the Blue Drum
author: Gus Tremblay
text: Oil's in the blue drum. Hand pump. HALF the glass, not full.
noticed: The pump handle is sticky with oil. Someone has written "No. 1" on the drum in marker, and crossed it out, and written it again.

title: On Doris's Dash
author: Gus Tremblay
text: If Doris won't start it's the plugs. It's always the plugs. Unless it's the choke.
noticed: The key with the Z on it is already in her. Gus said she knows if you use the spare.

title: The Drawer Labelled DORIS
text: Four new spark plugs in their boxes, a coin-type gap gauge, a plug socket, and a can of carb cleaner. Taped inside the drawer: "0.035. Hand tight then a QUARTER turn. Not a half. A QUARTER."
noticed: The drawers below are labelled DORIS (MISC) and DORIS (DON'T).

title: Glycol Out and Back
text: Two dial thermometers on the glycol mains, supply and return. The supply needle sits a bit under -9. The return reads about -6, if you tap the glass.
noticed: Gus's board of eleven retired thermometers hangs beside them. One is labelled HONEST ONE.

title: Valley Hydro: Statement
text: Millbrook Community Arena. Last month: $11,240.18. Clipped to it, in Gus's hand: "Ice is too thick. Earl likes it thick. Earl doesn't pay the bill."
noticed: Last September's bill is underneath. It was lower.

title: The Lighting Panel
text: A grey panel of breakers, each labelled in marker: ICE 1, ICE 2, ICE 3, LOBBY, BAY, LOT. Breaker 14 has tape over it and a note: "DON'T."
noticed: The ice lights are old metal halides. They take a few minutes to warm up to full.

title: The Snow Pit
text: The melt pit under the grate, where Doris dumps her snow. The heater coil is supposed to melt it down the floor drain.
